roleSessionValues.label: Session values
roleSessionValues.help: Constant values this role's row rules read as current_setting('provisa.<name>'). A value the request binds under the same name takes precedence. A role that inherits from this one gets these values, except the names it sets itself. A value may be a ${env:NAME} or ${secret:NAME} reference, resolved when a query uses it. A constant takes part in the query: Provisa's records of it are covered by central redaction, but a source's own logs are out of Provisa's reach.
